packageRules.description: Bedrock clients can only connect to a server within a narrow version window of the client's own build, so this image cannot be left to drift like a normal dependency. Auto-merge once CI -- including the boot smoke test -- is green; the StatefulSet's RollingUpdate strategy and the nightly backup are the safety net if a release still turns out bad after that.
kubectl/bash toolbox and the backup exporter's busybox -- version drift here has no client-compatibility pressure, so these stay PR-only for a human to merge.
AFK bot image bakes in protocol data for exactly one Bedrock version and must move in lockstep with a deliberate, hand-reviewed server bump -- never on its own.
